scope: Verified public seven-sport development search. Before/after comparisons use the same data hashes and validation games. Raw accuracy leaders can fail probability-quality requirements. These are not new independent test scores or automatic model promotions.

reviews.selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

reviews.note: Expanding development backtests only. Candidate selection gains are optimistic; no new independent test or production improvement is claimed. Original final-test dates were excluded. Production promotion still requires the separate prospective loss-review gate.
